title: Atomic Proximal Policy Optimization for Electric Robo-Taxi Dispatch and Charger Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2502.13392v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pioneering companies such as Waymo have deployed electric robo-taxi services in several U.S. cities. Operating such fleets requires coordinating ride matching, vehicle repositioning, and battery charging in a stochastic environment while accounting for limited charging infrastructure. Understanding both how to design efficient, scalable control algorithms for large fleets and how charger deployment shapes system performance is therefore critical for robo-taxi operators. We model the operations of an electric robo-taxi system as a discrete-time Markov decision process with a long-run average reward objective. To efficiently evaluate system performance under different configurations, we develop a scalable deep reinforcement learning algorithm, Atomic Proximal Policy Optimization (Atomic-PPO), which reduces the action space using atomic action decomposition. translated_title: 面向电动无人驾驶出租车调度与充电桩分配的原子近端策略优化
translated_abstract: Waymo等先驱公司已在多个美国城市部署了电动无人驾驶出租车服务。运营此类车队需要在随机环境中协调订单匹配、车辆重新定位和电池充电，同时还要考虑有限的充电基础设施。因此，对于无人驾驶出租车运营商而言，理解如何为大型车队设计高效、可扩展的控制算法，以及充电桩的部署如何影响系统性能，都是至关重要的。我们将电动无人驾驶出租车系统的运营建模为一个以长期平均奖励为目标的离散时间马尔可夫决策过程。为了高效评估不同配置下的系统性能，我们开发了一种可扩展的深度强化学习算法——原子近端策略优化，该算法通过原子动作分解来缩减动作空间。由此产生的训练过程只需要适度的计算资源。
tldr: 本文提出通过原子动作分解缩减动作空间、且仅需适度计算资源的可扩展深度强化学习算法Atomic-PPO，用于在充电基础设施受限的环境下对电动无人驾驶出租车车队进行调度与充电决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Atomic-PPO, a scalable deep reinforcement learning algorithm that uses atomic action decomposition to reduce the action space and requires only modest computational resources, for dispatch and charger allocation in electric robo-taxi fleets under limited charging infrastructure.
